data.notes: The report's strongest work is the 'decided' section. It challenges the rep's 'nothing to do' with the coverage facts: no business review in 9–10 months, Stefan never met, the evaluation found only at the renewal notice, and the analysis landing three weeks late. It also ties 'what's mine' to a sound per-customer-approvals messaging change, keeps Adyen's results unknown and adds no figures. It misses several points. The trigger and decider sections never state that the stakeholder change went unnoticed or that the decision was made before we engaged (the 'two weeks before the last call' timing is dropped), and the decider section wrongly calls the CFO's approval Elena's inference when she said Stefan told her. The runner-up tag is 'Support and service' rather than 'Champion or access'. The close omits which findings are fixable and the follow-up to act on them to protect the US account, and the rep takeaway leaves out the 'regular reviews even with no complaints' theme.
